independent_review.scope: Original static consistency review plus host C/C++ syntax/type/layout assertions only. No guest module execution, runtime ABI implementation validation, native UI/device run, signing/publication, or GA gate pass.

clarifications: Accepted design source prohibition means DispatchSource or external execution source; the two concrete data-only wake queues are explicitly required.
Fresh private host and captured issuer on rebinding, single native attachment, and final retirement hint before wake completion are normative in the new contract.
implementation_order: Additive full native UI export validator; preserve old native status/report/header domains and one archive/registry.
Strict value-only SDK UI/event/exchange/wake primitives under fixed SPI; no callbacks or owner references in shared exchange.
Fixed bridge startup/event/every-ready-turn composites and validation-before-I/O admission on the existing worker.
Private signed UI facade, installed-mode reservation, typed durable failure paths, joined presentation and actual native receipt.
Independent signed bytecode/KV/native-window integration and subsequent platform/published-package qualification.
limitations: Static review and syntax/layout checks do not validate an implemented C ABI or run any guest/native UI.
No implementation, effects, health, signing/release, physical-device, fullSwift/FieldLog or GA gate is passed by this freeze.
Old contracts, profiles, signature domains and default paths stay unchanged; actual linked input graph capture remains required.
